item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.11
item.description: Click links in embedded capture sessions to open them in their default macOS app. Closed sessions now show their status, an Open button, and a three-dot menu beside the capture title in notes, meetings, and QA reviews.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.12
item.description:
Dictation now pastes the local transcript by default. Turn on “Polish dictation with AI” in Settings → Dictation for AI cleanup. You can use AI Quick Actions with polishing off.
Dictation can paste into a terminal window when macOS cannot identify its text field. In Herdr, the transcript and screenshots go into the draft in order, with one paste per image. The draft stays open for review.
Using the shortcut in an empty Slack composer starts dictation without asking about old clipboard text. Selection lookup respects remapped Copy commands and macOS Secure Input.
Transcript and suggested-work dialogs resize with the capture pane.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.13
item.description:
Settings → AI processing now groups both switches. “Enable AI features” controls Quick Actions, meeting summaries, and note refinement. With AI features enabled, turn on “Use AI processing for dictation” to polish transcripts before pasting or saving them. Dictation polishing defaults off.
Selecting message text across a divider in a deeply nested web conversation can now open Quick Actions with the full selection.
Dictation now recognizes the original window when macOS first identifies it as the focused element during processing. This avoids a false “Input changed” in that case. The session log records which focus check blocked a paste.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.14
item.description: - Selection rewrites now use the same compact processing overlay as dictation. Quick Action cards are about 10% narrower. - Recording recovery retries temporary read failures and protects recovered work from stale edits. Recordings with long titles can become captures. - Setup Assistant saves your AI choice and completion together. Account sync clears obsolete conflicts after a sync category is turned off. - AI rewrites keep valid output when a provider omits token counts or returns unreadable counts. - Apple Silicon installers now carry their hardware requirement in the signed update feed. Intel source builds skip these downloads.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.15
item.description: - Meeting recording now accepts audio while the microphone starts. Startup buffers no longer cause a false interruption. - Dictation can paste into the same Herdr terminal when macOS identifies its window during AI polishing. A change of destination still blocks paste.
